operations.semantics: Projects a coherent generation/revision snapshot and explicitly marks absent snapshots stale.
Atomically reserves a bounded operation identity before network dispatch and submits an authenticated, revision-bound request.
Uses the authenticated identity/revision path for stop while preserving server-side authority and terminality.

invariants: The browser is never the runtime authority and never declares success from a local acknowledgement.
Every mutation binds session, connection generation, runtime generation, displayed revision, snapshot digest, operation id, semantic digest, target, action, and reason.
An operation id is reserved before the first await that can dispatch transport work.
Concurrent duplicate submissions share one in-flight promise; conflicting semantics fail closed.
Accepted-but-timeout is indeterminate and must be recovered by operation id before retry.
The backend operation-id unique constraint is the final idempotency authority.
Same generation and revision with a different semantic digest is snapshot drift and is rejected.
Control actions are disabled while the displayed view is stale or the session lacks the required permission.
